description: Read a YouTube transcript that is already published for this account, without starting a new fetch. Use it after transcriptlab_get_job_status reports a job done, or to re-open a variant that was delivered before. For a first request use transcriptlab_get_transcript instead. Pass the same engine/tier/diarize used for the original fetch so the read selects the matching artifact. Reading an already delivered variant is free; a never-before-delivered variant can spend credits like the original request.

diarize.description: Must match the original fetch; implies tier=premium for engine=stt.

engine.description: Selects the captions or speech-to-text artifact; must match the original fetch.

lang.description: Caption language, or optional ISO 639-1 spoken language hint when engine=stt (e.g. 'ar', 'en', 'tr'). Omit to auto-detect (recommended).

speakers.description: Speaker label renames; must match the original fetch.

tier.description: Speech tier for engine=stt; must match the original fetch.

translate.description: Translation target, if requested for the original fetch.

url.description: YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID.

name: transcriptlab_retrieve_transcript
title: Retrieve completed transcript
